'''Rian Ruh''' was a [[Je'daii Ranger]] who served the [[Je'daii Order]] during the earliest days of the Order on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Ruh discovered the [[Abyss of Ruh]] deep within the [[Rift]] on [[Talss]] and subsequently went mad.<ref name="NoP" />
